tests.name: desktop 1440x900, signed in: /admin/dashboard, /admin/members/directory, /admin/settings/feature-flags, /admin/autopilot/runs, /admin/audit/actions — for an admin account: ?spotlight=1 renders AdminTabs directly above [data-archetype="workspace"] (full width, no horizontal scroll) and ?spotlight=0 renders today's tree without [data-archetype]; for the non-admin test user: every route still renders NotAuthorized in place (no workspace frame, no admin tabs) and the admin-only part is skipped with that reason

admin page flag off = legacy tree (AdminTabs + padded wrapper, no [data-archetype]); flag on = AdminTabs directly above ScreenFrame "workspace" (full width, no rail, same content and controls); loading = workspace skeleton, no spinner; every admin page with AppLayout composes ScreenFrame "workspace" behind useSpotlightEnabled() and never moves AdminTabs inside it; Rewards Shop admin end-to-end over a mocked gateway still green
